definitions.doc_after:
Evaluate the published thermal-WDM power ratios at a matched background.

Parameters
----------
mass : float
    Thermal-relic particle mass in keV.
k : array_like
    Comoving wavenumber in h/Mpc.
h : float
    Dimensionless Hubble parameter.
omega_dm : float
    Physical dark-matter density Omega_dm*h**2.

Returns
-------
ratios : dict of numpy.ndarray
    Viel2005_q10 and Vogel2023_q10 are power ratios; historical_q5 retains the old amplitude-as-power control.

Notes
-----
The Viel and Vogel--Abazajian coefficient sets must be kept together with their own
density and shape conventions.

The Viel alpha uses Omega_dm, while Vogel uses omega_dm. Both alpha values have units Mpc/h. The Vogel spin-1/2 coefficient set includes nu=1.049 and is calibrated starting at 2 keV; evaluation at 1 keV is an extrapolation diagnostic. No coefficients are fitted to the CLASS outputs.

References
----------

.. [cite-viel] Viel et al. (2005), Constraining warm dark matter candidates including sterile neutrinos and light gravitinos with WMAP and the Lyman-alpha forest, Eqs. (6)-(7).
    https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0501562

.. [cite-vogel] Vogel & Abazajian (2023), Entering the Era of Measuring Sub-Galactic Dark Matter Structure: Accurate Transfer Functions for Axino, Gravitino & Sterile Neutrino Thermal Warm Dark Matter, Eqs. (7)-(9), Table II (v2).
    https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.10753

definitions.doc_after:
Convert the selected published transfer shape into an amplitude or squared-power control.

Parameters
----------
alpha : float
    Suppression scale in Mpc/h.
nu : float
    Dimensionless published shape exponent.
power_exponent : float
    10 for T**2; 5 reproduces the historical amplitude-as-power comparison.

Returns
-------
ratio : numpy.ndarray
    Dimensionless suppression at the enclosing k grid.

Notes
-----
The Viel and Vogel--Abazajian coefficient sets must be kept together with their own
density and shape conventions.

Squaring the amplitude doubles the exponent. Numerical evaluation with log1p changes neither the coefficients nor the power convention.

References
----------

.. [cite-viel] Viel et al. (2005), Constraining warm dark matter candidates including sterile neutrinos and light gravitinos with WMAP and the Lyman-alpha forest, Eqs. (6)-(7).
    https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0501562

.. [cite-vogel] Vogel & Abazajian (2023), Entering the Era of Measuring Sub-Galactic Dark Matter Structure: Accurate Transfer Functions for Axino, Gravitino & Sterile Neutrino Thermal Warm Dark Matter, Eqs. (7)-(9), Table II (v2).
    https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.10753

definitions.doc_after:
Run controlled catalogue grid and solver variations around one frozen halo setup.

Notes
-----
The literature threshold rt/rs > 0.77 follows the Hayashi et al. disruption prescription
adopted by Hiroshima et al. A caller-supplied threshold takes precedence in variants
that expose it (C and SI currently default to 0). This is a model selection rule; an
exact-boundary test does not calibrate disruption physics.

The setup fixes M200=1e12 Msun at z=0 and the literature truncation cut ct>0.77, then varies one quadrature or solver control at a time. Finite nonnegative weights and a gross mass-increase bound are implementation sanity conditions; resolution differences measure finite-grid sensitivity, not model calibration. Output paths must be new, and source revisions and script hashes accompany every catalogue.

References
----------

.. [cite-survival] Hayashi et al. (2003), The Structural Evolution of Substructure, Section 2.1.
    https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0203004

.. [cite-structure] Hiroshima, Ando & Ishiyama (2018), Modeling evolution of dark matter substructure and annihilation boost, Section II, Eqs. (4)-(9), (28), (34).
    https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.07691

definitions.doc_after:
Plot preserved CLASS power-ratio controls against fixed published transfer fits.

Notes
-----
The reviewed spectra hash is verified before plotting. The figure displays z=0 ratios and absolute fit residuals at 1, 2 and 5 keV, plus the independent 2-keV numerical refinement. Vogel at 1 keV is labelled as extrapolation. Caption background values are those of the WMAP7-labelled input table. Plotting does not refit coefficients or demonstrate observational constraints.

The input header stores Omega_b=0.0469, Omega_m=0.27, h=0.7, n_s=0.95 and sigma8=0.82.
In particular Omega_b and n_s do not equal the Table 1 best-fit values in Komatsu et
al. The WMAP7 label supplies historical context; it does not establish that these five
inputs reproduce a published WMAP7 parameter column or recover the original CAMB
configuration.

References
----------

.. [cite-viel] Viel et al. (2005), Constraining warm dark matter candidates including sterile neutrinos and light gravitinos with WMAP and the Lyman-alpha forest, Eqs. (6)-(7).
    https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0501562

.. [cite-vogel] Vogel & Abazajian (2023), Entering the Era of Measuring Sub-Galactic Dark Matter Structure: Accurate Transfer Functions for Axino, Gravitino & Sterile Neutrino Thermal Warm Dark Matter, Eqs. (7)-(9), Table II (v2).
    https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.10753

.. [cite-wmap] Komatsu et al. (2011), Seven-Year Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe Observations: Cosmological Interpretation.
    https://arxiv.org/abs/1001.4538

definitions.doc_after:
Freeze a CLASS control cosmology and its source provenance before comparing WDM spectra.

Parameters
----------
args : argparse.Namespace
    Command-line output path, CLASS executable and CLASS source-manifest path.

Notes
-----
The first five stored CAMB-header values set Omega_b, Omega_m, h, n_s and the CDM sigma8 target. Additional controls tau=0.0544 and starting A_s=2.1e-9 are rounded Planck-2018 choices; T_cmb=2.7255 K follows Fixsen and N_ur=3.046 follows Mangano et al. All active neutrinos are treated as massless in this control. These additional settings do not reconstruct undocumented original CAMB inputs. The CDM normalization is subsequently matched once, then shared with WDM. Numerical hierarchy and integration settings are convergence controls.

The input header stores Omega_b=0.0469, Omega_m=0.27, h=0.7, n_s=0.95 and sigma8=0.82.
In particular Omega_b and n_s do not equal the Table 1 best-fit values in Komatsu et
al. The WMAP7 label supplies historical context; it does not establish that these five
inputs reproduce a published WMAP7 parameter column or recover the original CAMB
configuration.

References
----------

.. [cite-planck] Planck Collaboration (2020), Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters, Table 2.
    https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209

.. [cite-cmb] Fixsen (2009), The Temperature of the Cosmic Microwave Background.
    https://arxiv.org/abs/0911.1955

.. [cite-neutrinos] Mangano et al. (2005), Relic neutrino decoupling including flavour oscillations.
    https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-ph/0506164

.. [cite-wmap] Komatsu et al. (2011), Seven-Year Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe Observations: Cosmological Interpretation.
    https://arxiv.org/abs/1001.4538

planck.title: Planck Collaboration (2020), Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters, Table 2.
planck.manual_comparison: H0=67.36, Omega_m=0.3153, omega_b=0.02237, tau=0.0544 and A_s=2.100e-9 support the rounded native/control inputs. Omega_b is obtained by dividing omega_b by h^2. The Colossus planck18 preset selects a different data combination; its name does not make it identical to the native parameter vector.

wmap.title: Komatsu et al. (2011), Seven-Year Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe Observations: Cosmological Interpretation.
wmap.manual_comparison: The paper is real and reachable, but the input header (Omega_b=0.0469, Omega_m=0.27, h=0.7, n_s=0.95, sigma8=0.82) is not a literal Table 1 column. In particular 0.0469 and 0.95 are absent as the cited best-fit values. The WMAP7 label is contextual; exact table-generation parameters are not established by this citation.

structure.title: Hiroshima, Ando & Ishiyama (2018), Modeling evolution of dark matter substructure and annihilation boost, Section II, Eqs. (5)-(9).
structure.manual_comparison: The paper gives the concentration prescription, NFW speed/radius conversion and tidal structural response. Section II adopts scatter 0.13 dex; the disruption discussion and later selection factors use r_t/r_s=0.77. C/SI defaults allowing zero cutoff and all public 0.128-dex scatter defaults are explicit implementation choices, not literal copies of every population setting.

survival.title: Hayashi et al. (2003), The Structural Evolution of Substructure.
survival.manual_comparison: The approximately 0.77*r_s bound concerns instantaneously truncated isotropic NFW systems. Adopting it as a subhalo survival selection follows the later Hiroshima prescription; it is not a universal empirical disruption threshold. Tests at the exact boundary establish mask and inversion behavior only.

viel.title: Viel et al. (2005), Constraining warm dark matter candidates including sterile neutrinos and light gravitinos with WMAP and the Lyman-alpha forest, Eqs. (6)-(7).
viel.manual_comparison: The amplitude T=[1+(alpha*k)^(2*nu)]^(-5/nu), nu=1.12 and alpha=0.049*(m/keV)^-1.11*(Omega_WDM/0.25)^0.11*(h/0.7)^1.22 h^-1 Mpc are printed. The power ratio has exponent -10/nu by squaring. The paper states k<5 h/Mpc for this fit. A q5 power control is historical and does not reproduce the squared transfer law.

vogel.title: Vogel & Abazajian (2023), Entering the Era of Measuring Sub-Galactic Dark Matter Structure: Accurate Transfer Functions for Axino, Gravitino & Sterile Neutrino Thermal Warm Dark Matter, Eqs. (7)-(9), Table II (v2).
vogel.manual_comparison: The amplitude definition, scale fit and spin-1/2 values a=0.0437, b=-1.188, nu=1.049, theta=2.012, eta=0.2463 are printed. Calibration uses 2,5,10,20,100 keV; the 1-keV comparison is extrapolation. The code correctly squares the amplitude for a power ratio.

cmb.title: Fixsen (2009), The Temperature of the Cosmic Microwave Background.
cmb.manual_comparison: The measured temperature is 2.72548 +/- 0.00057 K. The control input 2.7255 K is a rounded value. This supports the temperature choice only, not the recovery of every original CAMB setting.

neutrinos.title: Mangano et al. (2005), Relic neutrino decoupling including flavour oscillations.
neutrinos.manual_comparison: The paper reports N_eff=3.046 from non-instantaneous neutrino decoupling. The control puts that value into a massless-radiation setting. The all-massless treatment is a separate modelling choice, not a conclusion about neutrino masses in the cited paper.
